section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the love of "with all your soul" (bechol nafshecha) involves the intellect illuminating the heart, enabling a spontaneous flow of blessing from the hidden world to the revealed world.
section.t: And according to the known principle
that the service of man
(an arousal from below)
through which the drawing down is effected
(an arousal from above)
must be commensurate with the drawing down,
it must be said,
that the service through which blessing and drawing down are effected from the hidden world to the revealed world,
is the love of "with all your soul."
And the explanation is,
that the meaning of "with all your soul" is with all the powers of the soul,
intellect and emotions.
And it must be said that the intention in this is,
that the superiority of the love of "with all your soul" over the love of "with all your heart" is,
that in the love of "with all your heart" the primary element is the emotion
[therefore it is said of it "with all your heart," for the heart is the place where the emotions reside],
because the comprehension that gives birth to this love is in the externality of the intellect that relates to the emotions,
and the comprehension of this level is
in the brain and does not illuminate the heart,
therefore the generation of love from the intellect is not in an automatic manner, but rather the intellect must actively produce the love.
And in the love of "with all your soul,"
the comprehension from which the love comes is in the innerness of the intellect,
so that the comprehension of this level illuminates
the heart,
and the drawing down of love from the intellect is in an automatic manner.
Therefore it is said of it "with all your soul,"
all the powers of the soul,
because in this love the intellect is also felt.
[And one may connect this with what is explained elsewhere,
that the love of "with all your heart" is only in the heart, and the love of "with all your soul" is
(not only in the heart,
but)
spread also throughout all the powers and limbs,
and it must be said that the intention in this is,
that in the love of "with all your heart,"
the fact that he fulfills the commandments because of his love for Havayah is in a manner that the love acts upon his deed,
and in the love of "with all your soul,"
his fulfillment of the commandments is in an automatic manner.
And it must be said,
that the drawing down of the emotions into the powers that are below them is analogous to the drawing down of the emotions themselves,
that the emotions are drawn from the intellect in a manner of active causation,
that the intellect must actively produce the emotion,
and their drawing down into the powers below them is in a manner of active causation.
And the emotions that are drawn from the intellect in an automatic manner,
because the intellect also illuminates the heart—their drawing down into the powers below them is in a manner that the emotions themselves spread throughout all the powers and limbs,
and their effect upon the powers and limbs is in an automatic manner].
And since the intellects are hidden things and the emotions are revealed things,
therefore,
through the love of "with all your soul,"
where the intellects also illuminate the heart,
blessing and drawing down are effected from the hidden world to the revealed world.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the love of "with all your soul" corresponds to the transcendent light (Sovev), leading to self-sacrifice and connecting the encompassing and filling lights.
section.t: And there is a further explanation of the distinction between the love of "with all your heart" and the love of "with all your soul,"
that the love of "with all your heart" is in the aspect of "He fills all worlds,"
for since the life-force of the aspect of "He fills all worlds" is enclothed within the creations in their innerness,
therefore, through contemplation, this life-force is felt also in the animal soul,
and the love is "with all your heart," with both your inclinations.
And the love of "with all your soul" is in the aspect of "He encompasses all worlds,"
for since the encompassing light is above enclothement in the worlds,
therefore, when one feels through it the wondrousness of Ein Sof
(the encompassing),
his love for Havayah is in a manner of self-sacrifice,
even if He takes your soul.
And based on this,
the connection of the love of "with all your soul" to the drawing down from the hidden world
(the matter of blessing)
is not only regarding the hidden world as it is in the Sefiros,
Binah,
but also regarding the hidden world
(the encompassing)
as it is in the totality of revelations
(the filling).
And it must be said,
that this—that through the love that comes from the feeling of the wondrousness of Ein Sof, the drawing down is effected from the hidden world
(the encompassing)
to the revealed world
(the filling)—
is primarily when this love,
which is from the aspect of Chayah
(the encompassing),
is felt also in his Nefesh-Ruach-Neshamah
(the internal)
of him.
And through this, the union of the encompassing and the filling is effected.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the union of the encompassing and filling lights is achieved through the drawing down of Ein Sof that transcends both, as hinted by adding the letter Alef to the word "Mah" to form "Me'ah."
section.t: And it is known,
that in order for there to be the union of the encompassing and the filling, it is through the drawing down of Ein Sof that is above the encompassing and the filling.
And this is
"Do not read 'Mah' (what) but rather 'Me'ah' (one hundred),"
"Mah" is Malchus,
the filling,
"Me'ah" is Arich,
the encompassing,
and "Do not read 'Mah' but rather 'Me'ah'" means that even in "Mah"
(the filling)
there should be the drawing down of "Me'ah"
(the encompassing).
And the difference between "Me'ah" and "Mah" is that the letter Alef is added to it,
for Alef is the aspect of Atik
(the aspect of "one and not in number")
which is above the encompassing.
And it must be said,
that the reason for this—that by adding an Alef to the word "Mah" it becomes "Me'ah"—
is,
that Alef is the aspect of Atik,
through which the union of the encompassing
("Me'ah")
and the filling
("Mah") is effected,
and therefore,
through the
(addition of)
Alef, "Mah" becomes "Me'ah."
